column1: In September 2023, Meta joined Zero Emission Maritime Buyers Alliance (ZEMBA)↗. As a non-profit
organization and initiative of Cargo Owners for Zero Emissions Vessels (coZEV), the mission of ZEMBA
is to enable companies to access zero-emission shipping solutions that are not widely available.
Through ZEMBA, member companies such as Meta have aggregated their demand for zero-emission
shipping services into a tender for the green premium associated with zero-emissions fuels. As an
innovative buyers group, our long-term commitments for the offtake of zero emissions fuels will
stimulate growth in a new marketplace through building confidence among investors, carriers, ship
owners and producers of zero-emission fuels and vessels.
